192 files: 100 test suites holding 967 `[test]` functions, 92 compile-fail fixtures, 0 scripts. How a test tree is laid out and what each class of file is: `tests/ARCHITECTURE.md` at the repo root.

## benchctl/

### tests/test_bench.das

- `test_verbs` - the run verb records one file per lane and exits on the night's verdict, --failed records a night that never ran and report exits 0 or 1
- `test_load_runs` - run records load in commit order, a corrupt file is named and skipped, and a night's status derives from its results
- `test_build_dataset` - dataset series are keyed by lane and arm with run-indexed points, and the run summary carries failures and the ok count
- `test_classify_run_output` - a run's output classifies into samples, compile errors, failed functions, shutdown deaths and timeouts
- `test_run_bench_file` - a skipped file never spawns, a clean child is ok, a child past its timeout is killed keeping its arms and an unrunnable binary reports nothing measured
- `test_probe_jit` - the jit probe reports the lane available on a daslang that runs it and names the binary that cannot
- `test_load_suite_config` - a well-formed suite config parses with its overrides and a missing, unparseable or out-of-range one fails closed naming the fault
- `test_discover_files` - suite discovery excludes helpers, test dirs and non-das files, sorts the rest, applies overrides and reports an override naming a missing file

### tests/test_git_signature.das

- `test_extract_status_path_basic` - a modified or untracked status line yields its file name
- `test_extract_status_path_rename` - a rename status line yields the new name
- `test_extract_status_path_short` - a status line of three characters or fewer yields an empty path

- `test_filesystem_signature_predicate_filters` - a predicate on the extension makes other files invisible to the signature

- `test_compute_signature_returns_non_empty` - compute_signature returns a non-empty signature with a git: or fs: prefix
- `test_compute_signature_no_git_falls_back` - a system temp dir outside git gets an fs: signature

### tests/uncategorized.das

- `test_non_empty_lines` - non_empty_lines keeps the non-blank lines of a text
- `test_split_trimmed` - split_trimmed splits a text on a separator and trims each piece

## dap/

### test_dap_bridge.das

The DAP MCP bridge end to end: the bridge over a stdio pipe launching, attaching to and disconnecting from real debuggees, once with the instrumentation debugger and once with the stepping debugger; the frame parser's limits; the resume-command mapping; and the debugger fixtures that must run clean on their own.

- `test_debugger_fixtures` - the debugger worker is cancelled at shutdown, survives its context's destruction, restarts after ending and refuses a second thread
- `test_dap_frame_limits` - every malformed DAP frame is refused with its reason, an over-long header is refused early and a complete frame parses while an incomplete one waits
- `test_execution_command_mapping` - the resuming tools map onto their DAP commands
- `test_bridge_session` - the bridge speaks a full debug session over a pipe with both the instrumentation and the stepping debugger
- `test_disconnect_removes_runtime_instruments` - a disconnect detaches the debuggee so only instruments that fired before it count

## dascov/

### tests/test_exact_cov.das

- `test_simple_branch` - the report for a single if/else names the source, registers the functions and counts the taken and untaken branch exactly
- `test_simple_linear` - a straight-line program reports every line hit and no branches
- `test_multi_func` - called functions and main are hit while an uncalled function's lines are zero
- `test_nested_branch` - nested branches report which side of each branch was taken and which lines are covered
- `test_shared_module_not_instrumented` - the program is instrumented while a shared module outlives it without a coverage dependency

the folder holding a copied daslang and, if not "", its `sidecar`

- `test_tool_names` - -tool with no name lists the SDK tools, an unknown or path-shaped name is refused naming where it looked, das-fmt runs dasfmt.das and a name outside utils/ resolves under utils/internal/
- `test_tool_arguments` - -dasroot before -tool picks the root, a -- right after the name is the tool separator and a -tool after the script -- is the script argument
- `test_tool_by_binary_name` - a daslang copy named after a tool runs that tool and hands its children the right daslang
- `test_tool_project_root` - a tool takes the project root from the directory it runs in unless an explicit flag before -tool says otherwise

- `test_cache_probe_cycle_shape` - the cache probe's request plan is sixteen requests: eight first rounds on one opening, six replays, one other system prompt and one repeat
- `test_cache_probe_notes_and_kwargs` - each conversation gets its own long note that repeats identically, a body builds the same twice, and preserve_thinking rides the kwargs only on request
- `test_cache_probe_summary` - the probe's summary computes shares by kind, the cold start, the medians and the failures from a table of answers
- `test_cache_probe_warm` - the second sweep reads warm, and a refused request counts as failed without disturbing the shares of the answered ones

### test_detect_dupe.das

- `test_tokenize_basic` - tokenize_canonical splits a canonical string into its space-separated tokens.

- `test_tokenize_trailing_space` - tokenize_canonical ignores a trailing space instead of emitting an empty token.
- `test_minhash_signature_length` - A minhash signature always has 64 slots.
- `test_minhash_padding_for_short_input` - A minhash signature of a one-token input is still padded to 64 slots.
- `test_minhash_deterministic` - Identical token lists produce identical minhash signatures slot for slot.
- `test_jaccard_identical` - The jaccard estimate of a signature against itself is exactly 1.
- `test_jaccard_empty` - The jaccard estimate of two empty signatures is 0.
- `test_jaccard_length_mismatch` - The jaccard estimate of signatures of different lengths is 0.
- `test_jaccard_unrelated_low` - Token lists with nothing in common estimate a jaccard similarity below 0.3.
- `test_exact_groups_duplicates` - exact_buckets puts functions with identical canonical forms into one cluster and leaves the different one out.
- `test_exact_min_tokens_filter` - exact_buckets ignores functions shorter than the minimum token count.
- `test_exact_assigns_cluster_id` - exact_buckets gives members of a cluster the same cluster id and leaves unclustered records at minus one.
- `test_exact_singleton_not_reported` - exact_buckets does not report a function with no duplicate as a cluster.
- `test_sort_clusters_by_size` - sort_clusters ranks the larger cluster first.
- `test_sort_pairs_by_similarity` - sort_pairs ranks the more similar pair first.
- `test_fuzzy_near_duplicates_pair` - fuzzy_pairs reports two near-identical functions as one pair above the threshold.
- `test_fuzzy_skips_identical` - fuzzy_pairs does not pair functions whose canonical forms are identical.
- `test_fuzzy_skips_same_cluster` - fuzzy_pairs does not pair functions that already share an exact cluster.
- `test_fuzzy_length_ratio_gate` - fuzzy_pairs does not pair functions whose lengths differ too much.
- `test_fuzzy_min_tokens_filter` - fuzzy_pairs ignores functions shorter than the minimum token count.
- `test_export_import_basic` - A written export reads back with each record's name, line, lambda flag and canonical form intact.
- `test_export_import_recomputes_sig` - Importing with fuzzy matching on recomputes the 64-slot signature and the token count.
- `test_export_import_skips_sig_when_no_fuzzy` - Importing with fuzzy matching off skips the signature but still counts tokens.
- `test_import_missing_file` - read_import fails with a message for a file that does not exist.
- `test_import_malformed_json` - read_import fails with a message for a file that is not valid JSON.
- `test_import_bad_schema_version` - read_import rejects an unknown schema_version and names it in the error.

- `test_import_rejects_zero_line` - read_import drops a record whose line is 0 as malformed while accepting the envelope.
- `test_read_path_lines_basic` - read_path_lines_from_file skips comments and blank lines and trims the paths it keeps.
- `test_read_path_lines_missing_file` - read_path_lines_from_file fails with a message for a file that does not exist.
- `test_scan_das_files_dedup` - scan_das_files adds a file once however many times a directory is scanned with the same cache.
- `test_skip_ast_fuzz_selftest` - The corpus skips ast-fuzz selftest victims, with either path separator, and keeps the ast-fuzz driver.
- `test_chunk_files_contiguous_and_complete` - chunk_files splits files into contiguous chunks that rebuild the original list in order.
- `test_chunk_files_workers_one` - chunk_files with one worker returns a single chunk.
- `test_chunk_files_workers_more_than_files` - chunk_files makes one chunk per file when workers outnumber files.
- `test_chunk_files_empty_input` - chunk_files returns no chunks for no files.

- `test_merge_envelope_files_rejects_bad_schema` - merge_envelope_files rejects a shard with an unknown schema_version.
- `test_merge_envelope_files_missing_shard` - merge_envelope_files fails with a message when a shard is missing.

- `test_candidate_filter_keeps_mixed_clusters` - With the candidate filter, an exact cluster that contains a candidate is kept whole.

- `test_baseline_load_rejects_bad_schema` - load_baseline_canonicals rejects an unknown schema_version and names it in the error.

- `test_pattern_dispatch_two_identical_stmts` - Two identical top-level statements classify as a dispatch pattern noted as repeated twice.

- `test_apply_pattern_filter_preserves_candidate_flag` - The pattern filter leaves a surviving record's candidate flag set.

## gen1-to-gen2/

### tests/test_engine.das

Engine tests: offsets, the comment/string scan, and the edit set.  The cases that matter are the ones the design turns on - an edit inside a construct plus an edit around it, two edits at one offset, and a deletion that would eat a comment.

- `test_offsets` - the line index and span clamping give correct offsets at the edges
- `test_lexical_scan` - the lexical scan separates comments from literals including the traps, guards deletions and steps a line edge past a block comment
- `test_edits` - inner, outer and same-offset edits compose in one pass while overlapping edits and comment-eating deletions are refused
- `test_comment_conservation` - the comment-conservation gate catches loss, duplication and reordering

### tests/test_make.das

Make-syntax conversion, on the shapes the v1 grammar allows.  The expectations are byte-exact, including where comments land: a comment written before the type stays before it, one written after the type lands after the `(`, and one written inside a `Foo()` initializer joins the leading run - there is nowhere else for it to go once the parens are gone.

- `test_make_struct` - every v1 make-struct shape converts and nested make-structs compose in one pass
- `test_make_array` - array and tuple make forms convert and an element type moves outside the call
- `test_make_wrappers` - the array-of and table-of bracket forms and comprehensions convert keeping their bodies
- `test_make_compiles` - the converted make-syntax compiles as gen2
- `test_make_comments_conserved` - no make-syntax rule loses a comment or is refused

### tests/test_shapes.das

v1 spellings whose rewrite is not a delimiter substitution.  Each of these came back from converting a game's script tree in place: the output either did not parse or lost a brace. They are written to temporary files rather than to a checked-in fixture, because the formatter rewrites most of them on sight.

- `test_else_with_trailing_comment` - a comment after else leaves room for the brace
- `test_global_let_block` - a bare let heading a block of globals takes braces
- `test_typeinfo_condition` - a typeinfo condition is wrapped past its trait
- `test_call_macro_body` - a quoted body is converted like any other block
- `test_piped_make_literal` - a make-literal at the head of a pipe becomes an argument
- `test_stacked_block_closers` - blocks that end on one line each keep their brace
- `test_indexed_condition` - a condition anchored on its index is not wrapped from there
- `test_for_head_from_keyword` - the for head starts after the keyword rather than at the first iterator
- `test_literal_header_forms` - a capture list or an annotation still belongs to its literal
- `test_multiline_initializer` - a block in an initializer is not treated as a continued expression
- `test_bodyless_declaration` - a declaration with no body still gets one
- `test_match_subject` - a call macro spelled as a keyword parenthesises its subject
- `test_comment_does_not_end_a_body` - a comment between methods does not close the class
- `test_make_literal_closer` - a make-literal is converted past its closing bracket
- `test_static_elif` - static_elif takes parentheses like static_if
- `test_closer_and_generators` - an index next to the closer is not the closer and both generator spellings stay generators

### tests/test_stmt.das

Statement and declaration conversion: indentation becomes braces, conditions gain parentheses, and the result has to compile as gen2 - which is the only check that really says the rewrite worked.

- `test_statement_braces` - blocks, conditions and the else and recover joins get braces and the result compiles as gen2
- `test_v1_only_shapes` - v1-only shapes keep a keyword's head past a comment, take a type as an argument and keep a continued initializer in one expression
- `test_declaration_braces` - declaration bodies get braces and the converted declarations compile as gen2
- `test_statements_keep_comments` - converting statements and declarations loses no comment

### tests/uncategorized_rtti_strict_smart_pointers_false.das

End-to-end: read a v1 file, parse it with infer off, apply the edit set, and hand back text whose comments are provably intact.

- `test_convert_pipeline` - converting a v1 file adds the gen2 header, keeps every comment, handles the semicolon and gen1.5 modes, still compiles as v1 and leaves an already-gen2 file byte for byte
- `test_crlf_input` - a CRLF file converts to the same result as its LF twin, with CRLF endings and every comment conserved

- `test_user_macro_break_is_reported_mid_pass` - a null a user macro leaves mid-pass is reported under both verify modes and fails the compile
- `test_user_macro_break_is_reported_run_start` - a null a user macro leaves at run start is reported under both verify modes and fails the compile
- `test_user_macro_break_at_optimize_is_reported` - a null an [optimization_macro] leaves is reported by --ast-verify-batch and fails the compile
- `test_ast_verify_batch_clean_on_valid_code` - --ast-verify-batch on valid code exits 0 and prints no AST verify report
- `test_ast_verify_skips_late_extern_stubs` - the post-infer verify skips a never-inferred dasbind stub body and exits 0
- `test_every_visitor_deref_has_a_repair` - gen_invariants finds a repair for every child deref the visitor makes

- `test_a_binary_that_does_not_start_stops_the_driver` - a --bin that cannot start makes the driver exit 2 naming it, with no run classified

- `test_process_path_missing_file` - a missing input file reports missing_file, not no_change
- `test_process_path_directory` - a directory passed as the input reports not_a_file, not no_change
- `test_collapse_double_blank` - two blank lines in a row collapse to one
- `test_collapse_many_blank` - a run of four blank lines collapses to one
- `test_preserve_single_blank` - a single blank line is kept
- `test_no_blanks_unchanged` - text with no blank lines comes back unchanged
- `test_collapse_whitespace_only_blank` - lines holding only spaces or tabs count as blank and collapse to the first of the run
- `test_collapse_idempotent` - collapsing blank lines a second time changes nothing
- `test_collapse_preserves_crlf` - collapsing blank lines in CRLF input keeps the CRLF line ends
- `test_apply_all_rules_chains_collapse` - the rule chain runs the blank-line collapse after the docstring strip, so a top-level triple blank becomes one

### line-length/test_line_length.das

- `test_code_width` - a code line past CODE_LIMIT columns is a finding and one at it is not, with a tab as TAB_WIDTH columns, a multi-byte character as one, and only added lines measured
- `test_moved_and_annotation_lines` - a line that left another place in the same diff is a move and is not measured, and a one-line annotation is exempt from the code width
- `test_comment_width` - a comment is measured from its marker without its indentation, on line, trailing, block-continuation and nested-block comments alike
- `test_lexing` - a comment marker inside a string or an interpolated string is code, and a quote character literal opens no string
- `test_skips` - a non-.das file and a file marked generated are never measured
- `test_folder_limits` - a limit of 0 turns a measure off, a wider limit admits the line, and each key comes from the nearest .lint_config with the defaults filling the rest
- `test_diff_base` - with no --base the diff base is origin/<default branch>, and a given --base is used as written
- `test_untracked` - the untracked list keeps only .das paths with blank lines and CR dropped, and every line of a file, the empty tail included, counts as added
- `test_untracked_files_are_checked` - the tool fails on a long line in an untracked file, names it, and never reads a gitignored one
- `test_base_option_reaches_git` - the --base value reaches git merge-base as given, never prefixed with origin/
- `test_added_lines` - a unified diff yields the added line numbers of each surviving file and nothing for a deleted one

### make-pr/test_gates.das

- `test_default_log_floor_to_info` - an unset DAS_LOG_LEVEL is raised to info and a level the caller set is left standing
- `test_main_prints_its_gate_lines_with_no_floor_set` - make-pr started with DAS_LOG_LEVEL unset still prints its gate lines
- `test_want_gate` - with no flags every gate is wanted, --only wants just the named gate, and --skip drops just the skipped one
- `test_in_default_chain` - sync, stamp-reach and jit-smoke run by default, and every named-only gate runs only under its own --only
- `test_unknown_gate_names` - a misspelled gate name in --only or --skip is reported, and known names report nothing
- `test_scopes_of` - changed files scope to their deduplicated parent folders, backslashes normalized, and a root-level file adds no scope
- `test_any_path_matches` - a path prefix matches a backslash-spelled file, any pattern of several can hit, and an unrelated prefix does not
- `test_pick_newest` - an existing binary candidate wins over a missing one, and no existing candidate yields an empty path

### pr-babysit/uncategorized.das

- `test_has_path_under` - a changed path under the prefix arms the gate, CR-terminated or not, while a look-alike elsewhere in the path or an empty diff does not

- `test_tier_runs` - the fast tier always runs, a lane runs only under --full, and a module gate never runs from a tier
- `test_sweep_excluded` - the sweep excludes listed trees by whole path segment, each with a reason, and excludes a module-gated tree exactly when the box lacks its module
- `test_sweep_root_text` - only text with an exported main is a sweep root, and one requiring the dasllama engine is a heavy root
- `test_failed_files_block` - the FAILURES block names the failed files, five at most with the rest counted, and a stated default when the block is absent
- `test_line_length_run` - the line-length gate passes the base as given, passes on rc 0, and fails on rc 1 naming the base
- `test_lint_pass_detail` - the lint pass detail names the rails that ran and any files --fix rewrote, and the darwin mirror runs only where the box carries dasVulkan
- `test_lint_inputs` - a .das or .md file is a lint input and an .rst, .cpp or .txt is not
- `test_lint_gate_files` - the lint gate takes every changed lint input except the tree-sitter grammar copy
- `test_count_fixed_files` - the lint output counts one rewritten file per line starting with FIXED, and none without --fix
- `test_lane_groups` - each run-only lane gets a child of its own in the given order, and the lanes that build in the shared build dir share one child, since two builds in one dir collide

- `test_cc_key_folds_case_where_the_filesystem_does` - the database key folds case on Windows and macOS and keeps it elsewhere, so each file has one spelling

- `test_used_enum_require` - a module whose enum value is used is tagged used:referenced with enum-type references

### test_tools_arch_discover.das
